verdicts.quote: Method readBytes() allocates byte array of size (int)contentLength without reasonable limit. contentLength is read as unsigned int from attacker-controlled stream via unsignedExtend(in.readInt()), allowing values up to Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1 (2,147,483,647).
verdicts.why: The exploitable mechanism named is precisely an untrusted length field sizing an allocation that happens up front, before the claimed payload bytes are read/proven present.

Neither finding concerns recursive decoding. F01 is timestamp multiplication overflow and F02 is heap allocation from a length field; nothing in this list mentions readTable/readArray mutual recursion or missing depth limits.
